sources.authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations

sources.scope: Universities, colleges, and standalone higher education institutions
sources.limitations: Survey year matters; do not imply current recognition from historical AISHE presence alone.

sources.limitations: Recognition and violation lists are time-sensitive and must retain retrieval date.

sources.authority: All India Council for Technical Education
sources.limitations: Approval is academic-year and programme specific; import the official year with every record.
